doc.title: rasson_ox_9ft — pocket-assembly declaration (V18) for the GULLY-C1 proposal (the served OX drop-pocket assembly)
doc.status: DECLARATION of the served model as built (table.js roxCornerPocket / roxSidePocket, OB-ROX-GEO-001 CP-12 / SP-12 / RC-29 / RC-30 / PK-03); the module is UNARMED on rasson_ox_9ft — this file is read only when it is armed
doc.notes: MESH NAMES ARE THE SCENE NAMES: rasson_ox_9ft sets render.dmNames = true and table.js dmFor prefixes every OX mesh dm-<part>; the pocket tags are the builder's (corner: nxnz pxnz nxpz pxpz by the sign of x and z; side: nz pz). The closed bucket / floor solids are declared solid_simplification: true — they are the real drop-pocket floor the OX ships (PK-01), i.e. where a hypothetical gully variant would be open.
